notes.title: This game is going to be removed from the Steam Store.
notes.notes:
Hi there,

After careful consideration, and feedback from the community, I have decided to remove this game from Steam.

Regrettably, the game was not my best work, and is lacking in many areas.  The decision to remove it is mostly due to gameplay being sub-par.

When making the game, I wanted to focus on graphics and atmosphere, which resulted in me paying very little attention to the actual gameplay.


Thank you for all who supported it, and thanks for all your support and understanding in general.

Kind Regards,
David
